title: Datamosh and RGB block-slice glitch cut
blurb: One ElementGL WebGL 2 canvas transitions between two live HTML views through a ping-pong motion-smear FBO for macroblock datamosh, scan-line tearing and RGB chroma shatter while keeping buttons and text inputs interactive.
question: Can one ElementGL WebGL 2 canvas composite two live HTML views across a ping-pong motion-smear FBO for datamosh, scan-tear and RGB chroma-shatter cuts while keeping buttons, toggles and text inputs clickable?
result: Measured in headless Chrome 160.0.8188.0 canary (2026-11-27, 412 px DPR 2.625 and 960 px DPR 2): 6/6 live checks pass on one ElementGL context (0.98 MP, 7.86 MB at rest; 0 GL errors with clean FBO/VAO unbind, 43/45 blocks altered and max 199 RGB split at mid-cut, live hits routed to Scene A at 0% and Scene B at 100%). Chrome 159 on Android and check:jank stay not verified.
